Elliot —

Thanks for the ask. Attached is a compact MAP draft plus an assumptions workbook (unit_econ_assumptions.xlsx). High level summary below; full MAP in the attachment.

Overview (what we'll validate in pilot):
- Tokens per request: capture 90th / median tokens for prompts & responses
- Avg response length: target 60–120 tokens for customer-facing workflows
- Caching: prefix caching for static context (expected hit 25–40% in first pass)
- Batching: server-side batching target 8 concurrent requests per batch for low-latency route; optional 32 for background workers
- KV cache reuse: measure session-level reuse and cold-start penalty (goal: 70% warm cache in rolling 24h)
- Model variants: baseline run on quantized 8-bit gpt-compat model vs high-accuracy float variant for A/B

Checkpoints & artifacts:
- Week 1 (smoke): traffic profile & tokens-per-minute snapshot + sample traces (Redwood Console link)
- Week 2 (eval): full token breakdown, cost projection tokens/$, batching/caching logs, and 3 quality eval prompts + human scorecard
- Week 3 (stability): sustained throughput run, failure modes, fallback behavior (model variant fallback metrics)

Metrics we'll provide (delivered by Redwood):
- Tokens consumed (prompt / completion / total) and tokens-per-user estimate
- Estimated tokens per dollar (tokens/$) for the observed profile and for three sensitivity scenarios (baseline / 2x traffic / 50% caching improvement)
- CPU/GPU-utilization and per-request latency distribution
- Cache hit-rate, average KV fetch time, and batching effectiveness (tokens saved / ms cost tradeoff)

Proposed timeline (close gated on econ pass):
- Draft MAP to you: Fri Apr 2 (attached)
- SynapseRx feedback: by Wed Apr 7
- Pilot start: Mon Apr 12
- Eval readout & go/no-go: Fri Apr 30
- Target contract signature: Wed May 5 (contingent on econ acceptance)

Next steps for us: Ben and Karthik will populate the assumptions workbook with technical/batching knobs and a preliminary tokens/$ estimate. Marissa, can you confirm we can commit the small dedicated slot the week of Apr 12?

Thanks — sending the attachments now.

— Stephanie

Adding the technical assumptions (summary) — I put the full numbers into unit_econ_assumptions.xlsx:

Traffic / request profile (SynapseRx pilot):
- Expected concurrent users during peak pilot: ~40 sessions (conversational flows)
- Average prompts per session: 3 prompts; median prompt length 30 tokens
- Avg model completion length (customer-facing): 85 tokens (target 60–120)

Unit-econ assumptions we used for initial tokens/$:
- Baseline model (quant-8): GPU throughput ~420 tokens/sec on instance type; blended cost $0.0009 per 1k tokens (pilot estimate)
- Accuracy model (float16): ~280 tokens/sec; blended cost $0.0023 per 1k tokens
- Estimated tokens per user per day (baseline): 3 * (30 + 85) = 345 tokens
- Projected tokens/$ (baseline): ~1,111 tokens per $1 (sensitivity sheet shows -30% / +50% cases)

Caching and batching knobs:
- Prefix caching: assume 30% hit rate initially — reduces prompt tokens by ~25% when hit
- KV cache reuse: goal 70% session warm; cold-start penalty ~+150ms and +20 tokens to prime cache
- Batching: for UI routes (low latency) we target batch size 8 with <150ms added delay; for background jobs we will test batch 32 where 30–40% token efficiency gains were observed in similar workloads

Measurement artifacts we'll ship:
- Per-route token histograms and tokens-per-minute CSVs
- Batching efficiency table (tokens saved / latency added)
- Raw trace sample for 25 requests with headers showing fallback/variant switching

Caveats: caching hit-rates are workload-dependent; we'll run a 72h profiling window to adjust projections. Also note tokens/$ will change materially based on model variant mix (we show three portfolio scenarios in the workbook).

— Ben
